Amended posting:

This requirement is for the Overton Brooks VAMC in Shreveport, LA.  This is not for the Alexandria LA VAMC.  All equipment is located in Shreveport, LA.  Disregard any reference to Alexandria VAMC.

Original posting:

This is a sources sought notice for Kubota mulcher maintenance and service at the Alexandria LA VAMC located in Pineville LA.  This is not a formal Request for Quote.  If your firm is interested in participating in a future RFQ, contact the CO at the email address listed.  SDVOSB firms are encouraged to participate.

See the attached RFI document which includes the Peformance Work Statement.
